decision.reason: The only prose evidence [ev-bea0311eb482] gives the subject and the change: the `IPWhiteList` middleware is renamed to `IPAllowList` with no configuration changes. It does not say what happens to an operator who keeps using `IPWhiteList` in v3 (whether it is rejected, ignored or still accepted as a deprecated alias), so the consequence cannot be written from it. The CRD schema artifacts also argue against a clean rename: the validator found traefik.io Middleware `spec.ipWhiteList` in the schema of both v2.11.2 [ev-4fd00a8d9fd6] and v3.0.0 [ev-0842f8f3bd9d], and refuted the field-renamed change on that basis. We need evidence on whether the old name still works in v3, for example a deprecation or removal statement, before the consequence and applicability can be decided.
